format: Gym Heroes (G1, 2000): cards not already in the pool. Unlimited only.

attacks.name: Phoenix Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck (after doing damage).

abilities.name: Bench Guard
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, whenever 1 of your other Benched Pokémon is damaged, you may have 10 of that damage done to this Pokémon instead. If more than 1 of your Benched Pokémon is damaged at the same time, you may use this power once for each of them.

attacks.name: Lariat
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Fairy Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, return any number of your Pokémon in play and all cards attached to them to your hand.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. On tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Take Away
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. Then your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck.

abilities.name: Pollen Defense
abilities.text: If an attack damages this Pokémon while it's your Active Pokémon (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Confused. This power works even if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from this Pokémon equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after Weakness and Resistance), rounded up to the nearest 10.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack. Flip a coin for each Lightning Energy card discarded this way. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Repeating Drill
attacks.text: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Energy Charge
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may move a Lightning Energy card attached to 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mega Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Knockout Needle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 60 more damage; otherwise, this attack does 30 damage.

abilities.name: Flee
abilities.text: Whenever an attack does damage to this Pokémon while it's your Active Pokémon, you may switch it with 1 of your Benched Pokémon; that prevents all other effects of that attack on this Pokémon. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Jellyfish Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned; if tails, it becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Crosscounter
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), flip a coin. On heads, this Pokémon attacks the Defending Pokémon for double that damage.

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.text: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, you may return it to your hand after discarding it. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when it's Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Fire Wall
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), this Pokémon attacks the Defending Pokémon for 10 damage (apply Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Shadow Images
attacks.text: Whenever this Pokémon is attacked, your opponent flips a coin. On tails, that attack does no damage to this Pokémon. (Any other effects of the attack still happen.) This lasts until this Pokémon takes damage, moves to the Bench or evolves.

attacks.name: Pain Amplifier
attacks.text: Put a damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon that already has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Call of the Night
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent shuffles the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose up to 3 of them. Does 10 damage to each of them. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Tunneling
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose up to 2 of them. Does 20 damage to each of them. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Horn Toss
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Needles
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Sandstorm
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. On tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Alert
attacks.text: Draw a card. Then switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You can't use this attack if you have no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Moonwatching
attacks.text: Look through your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Comet Slap
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Fragrance Trap
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads and your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with their Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Electric Current
attacks.text: Take a Lightning Energy card attached to this Pokémon and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you have no Benched Pokémon, discard that Energy card.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy cards attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.text: All damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 10 (after Weakness and Resistance). (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Triple Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Horn Hazard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Water Ring
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) that isn't a Water Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mysterious Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Jellyfish Pod
attacks.text: Look through your deck for any number of Tentacool, Tentacruel, Misty's Tentacool and/or Misty's Tentacruel cards. Show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

abilities.name: Restless Sleep
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Asleep and your opponent's attack damages it (even if it's Knocked Out), this power does 20 damage to the attacking Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

attacks.name: Collapse
attacks.text: This Pokémon becomes Asleep (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Healing Pollen
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon (all of them from a Pokémon that has fewer).

attacks.name: Sonic Distortion
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Shake
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Fire Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Child's Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: One-Two Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Lava Burst
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck (all of them if there are fewer). This attack does 20 damage times the number of Fire Energy cards discarded this way.

attacks.name: Lucky Shot
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) You can't use this attack if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiral Dive
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Rock Toss
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Strange Barrier
abilities.text: Whenever an attack by a Basic Pokémon (even your own) does 20 or more damage to this Pokémon (after Weakness and Resistance), reduce that damage to 10. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Tail Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Deflector
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever this Pokémon takes damage, divide that damage in half (rounded down to the nearest 10). (Any other effects still happen.)

attacks.name: Egg Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does no damage to the Defending Pokémon and this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Psychic Exchange
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw 5 cards.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

attacks.name: Healing Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, remove 4 damage counters from this Pokémon (all of them if it has fewer).

attacks.name: Magic Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed or Poisoned (your choice).

attacks.name: Dream Dance
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon and this Pokémon become Asleep (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Vile Smell
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon and this Pokémon become Confused (after doing damage).

abilities.name: Photosynthesis
abilities.text: All Energy attached to this Pokémon provides Grass Energy instead of its usual type. This power works even if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Flytrap
attacks.text: Before doing damage, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with their Active Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Removal Pulse
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. On heads, choose 1 of those Energy cards and discard it.

attacks.name: Confusion Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Super Fang
attacks.text: Does damage to the Defending Pokémon equal to half its remaining HP (rounded up to the nearest 10).

attacks.name: Rapids
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. On heads, choose 1 of those Energy cards and discard it.

attacks.name: Water Punch
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Call for Friend
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, look through your deck for a Basic Pokémon card with Misty in its name and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Mud Splash
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Crystal Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent can't attach Energy cards to the Defending Pokémon during their next turn.

attacks.name: Night Spirits
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the total number of Sabrina's Gastly, Sabrina's Haunter and Sabrina's Gengar you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Good Night
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Good Morning
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep, it is no longer Asleep.

attacks.name: Naptime
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, remove 3 damage counters from this Pokémon (all of them if it has fewer), and this Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Screaming Headbutt
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Screaming Headbutt during your next turn.

attacks.name: Kindle
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack. If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

attacks.name: Blaze
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Grass Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: 3-Pronged Tail
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Full Speed Charge
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads, and this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself times the number of tails.

abilities.name: Natural Healing
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from this Pokémon. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Tail Fan
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Call for Friend
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, look through your deck for a Basic Pokémon card with Brock in its name and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Hook Shot
attacks.text: Don't apply Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Taunt
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fidget
attacks.text: Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 40 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bellow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Drill Tackle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Sand Pit
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Poison Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Careless Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, remove 1 of them.

attacks.name: Sporadic Sponging
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, flip a coin. On heads, remove 1 of them.

attacks.name: Stretch Vine
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them. Does 20 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lightning Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, the base damage of this Pokémon's Gnaw attack is doubled.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Razor Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Spin Ball
attacks.text: Flip 1 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. On tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Hypnotic Stare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed; if tails, it becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Clamp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed. On tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Loop
attacks.text: Return a Psychic Energy card attached to this Pokémon to your hand in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Suggestion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Spook
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sleight of Hand
attacks.text: Choose up to 3 cards from your hand and put them on top of your deck in any order. Then look through your deck for that many basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Lazy Attack
attacks.text: This Pokémon becomes Asleep (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Poison Antennae
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Removal Beam
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. On heads, choose 1 of those Energy cards and discard it.

cards.name: The Rocket's Trap
cards.text: Flip a coin. On heads, choose up to 3 cards at random from your opponent's hand (without looking at them). Your opponent shuffles those cards into their deck.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz #1
cards.text: Put a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent its name. Your opponent guesses the length of that Pokémon. Then reveal the card. If your opponent guessed right, they draw 2 cards; if wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Brock
cards.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.name: Charity
cards.text: Attach this card to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, unless that Pokémon was Knocked Out, return this card to your hand. If that Pokémon attacks and does damage to the Defending Pokémon this turn, you may reduce that damage by any amount (in multiples of 10).

cards.name: Erika
cards.text: You may draw up to 3 cards, then your opponent may draw up to 3 cards.

cards.name: Lt. Surge
cards.text: Put a Basic Pokémon card from your hand into play as your Active Pokémon. Put your old Active Pokémon onto your Bench. You can't play this card if your Bench is full or you have no Basic Pokémon in your hand.

cards.name: No Removal Gym
cards.text: A player must discard 2 cards from their hand in order to play an Energy Removal or Super Energy Removal card.

cards.name: The Rocket's Training Gym
cards.text: Each player pays Colorless more to retreat their Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Blaine's Last Resort
cards.text: You can't play this card if you have any other cards in your hand. Show your hand to your opponent (it's empty), then draw 5 cards.

cards.name: Brock's Training Method
cards.text: Look through your deck for a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card with Brock in its name, show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Celadon City Gym
cards.text: During each player's turn, that player may discard an Energy card attached to 1 of their Pokémon with Erika in its name. If they do, that Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed or Poisoned.

cards.name: Cerulean City Gym
cards.text: Each player pays Colorless less to retreat their Pokémon with Misty in their names.

cards.name: Erika's Maids
cards.text: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to play this card. Look through your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and/or Evolution cards with Erika in their names, show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Erika's Perfume
cards.text: Look at your opponent's hand. If they have any Basic Pokémon cards there, you may put any number of them onto their Bench (as long as there's room).

cards.name: Good Manners
cards.text: You can play this card only if you have no Basic Pokémon cards in your hand. Show your hand to your opponent. Look through your deck for a Basic Pokémon card, show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Lt. Surge's Treaty
cards.text: Your opponent chooses 1: each player takes 1 of their own Prize cards and puts it into their hand, or you draw a card.

cards.name: Minion of Team Rocket
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Return that Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand. If either of them is tails, your turn ends immediately (you can't attack).

cards.name: Misty's Wrath
cards.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. Choose 2 of them and put them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

cards.name: Pewter City Gym
cards.text: Don't apply Resistance to any attacks made by Pokémon with Brock in their names.

cards.name: Recall
cards.text: For your attack this turn, your Active Pokémon can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon card or any Evolution card attached to it. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.)

cards.name: Sabrina's ESP
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name. At the end of your turn, discard it. If that Pokémon uses an attack that makes you flip coins, you may flip all of those coins again once.

cards.name: Secret Mission
cards.text: Look at your opponent's hand. Then you may discard any number of the other cards in your hand and draw that many cards.

cards.name: Tickling Machine
cards.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent sets their hand aside face down; no one can look at those cards. At the end of your opponent's next turn, they put those cards back into their hand. On tails, your turn ends immediately (you can't attack).

cards.name: Vermilion City Gym
cards.text: Whenever a player attacks with a Pokémon with Lt. Surge in its name, that player may flip a coin. If heads and the attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage. On tails, the attacking Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Blaine's Gamble
cards.text: Discard any number of the other cards from your hand. Then flip a coin. On heads, draw twice that many cards.

cards.name: Energy Flow
cards.text: Return any number of Energy cards attached to your Pokémon to your hand.

cards.name: Misty's Duel
cards.text: Play Rock-Paper-Scissors with your opponent. The winner shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 5 cards.

cards.name: Narrow Gym
cards.text: No player can have more than 4 Benched Pokémon. When this card is played, each player with 5 Benched Pokémon chooses 1 of them and returns it and all cards attached to it to their hand (your opponent does this first).

cards.name: Sabrina's Gaze
cards.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws that many cards.

cards.name: Trash Exchange
cards.text: Count the cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your deck. Then discard that many cards from the top of your deck.
